spec: draft-etcheverry-action-ref-05 (preimage four-field + receipt envelope optional fields)
derivation: Each anchor is a fixed runtime tool-binding case. Inputs: authorized_tool (tool identity declared at approval time), dispatched_tool (tool identity actually resolved at execution time), action_type (semantic label carried in the preimage), effective_args (dispatched parameters), effective_args_digest (SHA-256 over JCS of effective_args, per the -05 receipt envelope), authority_verified_at_ms / revocation_check_at_ms (freshness-layer optional fields), policy_scope_max (bound ceiling where applicable). Expected verdicts: BINDS = the settlement-time check required by the payments extension (Company verifies the delegated principal equals the operation's approved subject, and the dispatched tool/params equal the approved declaration) passes; REFUSES = it must fail closed with the stated reason class.
author_set: Correctover (github.com/DSHCorrectover) — computed with an independent verifier written from draft-etcheverry-action-ref-05 alone, with no reference to the trail, agentavow or agentgraph canonicalizer implementations. verify.py in this directory is that verifier; it is dependency-free and reproduces every verdict below byte-for-byte. A second independently written verifier (verifier-two) is being added under the same corpus; the zero-disagreement requirement is part of the author-set discipline.

failure_modes.fails-open-label: action_type label matches but dispatched tool identity differs. A relying party that checks only the semantic label sees a match that is not there.
failure_modes.fails-open-params: Tool identity matches but dispatched args exceed the approved declaration. The digest verifies against the dispatched args, so integrity alone cannot catch widening — only a comparison against the approved declaration can.
failure_modes.fails-open-stale: Tool and params match but authority/revocation timestamps fall outside the policy window at settlement time.
failure_modes.refuses: The binding check rejects and produces a reason class; no BINDS verdict is representable through these paths.

purpose: Runtime tool-binding cases that a digest-only pipeline cannot decide. The preimage/anchor layer proves the record was not tampered with; this suite proves the tool identity and parameter set behind the record still bind to the approved declaration at settlement time.

anchors.name: b3-exact-tool-and-params
anchors.note: Happy path: dispatched tool equals approved tool, effective_args_digest recomputes from effective_args, freshness fields inside window.

anchors.name: b3-tool-substitution-same-prefix
anchors.note: Semantic label carried in the preimage still says payment.send, but the dispatched tool is payments.refund. A digest-only pipeline passes this case; a binding check must not.

anchors.name: b3-label-case-variant
anchors.note: Label differs from the approved action_type only by case. action_type is an exact-match string in the -05 preimage table; no normalization is defined, so fail closed.

anchors.name: b3-param-widening-amount
anchors.note: Tool identity matches and the digest is internally consistent, but the dispatched amount exceeds the approved ceiling. Integrity cannot catch this; only comparison against approved_params can.

anchors.name: b3-stale-authority-at-settlement
anchors.note: Tool and params bound, but authority_verified_at_ms falls outside the freshness window at settlement. Exercises the freshness-layer optional fields as a settlement-time MUST.

anchors.name: b3-delegated-subject-in-scope
anchors.note: Delegation chain A->B->C; agent_id in the preimage is C after full delegation resolution (preimage agent_id is the chain tail per -05 delegation-resolution section); C dispatches the approved tool within scope. Per -05 section on delegation resolution, BINDS.
